Brini Bruni

Data deletion

This feed stores only what is described on the privacy page: captions, dates, links, and small thumbnails of Brini Bruni’s own public Instagram posts. It holds no data about visitors.

How to request deletion

  1. Email hello@brinibruni.com with a link to the post or a description of what you want removed.
  2. The post and its thumbnails are removed from this feed, and you get a reply when it is done.

If you are the account holder

Delete the post on Instagram. The next daily update removes it here, as long as it is one of your 50 most recent posts. Older posts can be removed by deleting their page from the site’s repository.
